How the reference pictures align with the target video — Picture 1 (from Shot 1) aligns with the 0.00-second mark of the target video; Picture 2 (from Shot 3) aligns with the 8.00-second mark of the target video.

integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] 2D-animated rotoscope painted animation in the style of a 1983 fantasy film: inked figures over painted backgrounds, broad graphic acting with strong gesture and clear body poses. The opening frame matches <Picture 1>: A hand with a red wristband grips a thick tree trunk, part of an arm extending from the lower right corner. The camera stays low and tilts up slightly as the figure moves. The camera pushes in with small amplitude at slow speed, tightening toward the face. On screen: muscular, blond, long, braided, light brown, red wristbands, necklace with white teeth and gold pendant. He shifts his weight, turns his shoulders, and brings one arm up across his chest before letting it fall. [Shot 2] At 00:01.001, the camera cuts to a new angle. The camera pushes in with small amplitude at slow speed, tightening toward the face. On screen: a young athletic man with shoulder-length blond hair, bare-chested in a brown loincloth with a gold buckle, arm bands and black boots, carrying a sword. He shifts his weight, turns his shoulders, and brings one arm up across his chest before letting it fall. [Shot 3] At 00:04.838, the camera cuts to a new angle. The camera stays low and tilts up slightly as the figure moves. The camera arcs around the figures with small amplitude at slow speed, shifting the angle across the passage. The move slows and stops as the figure settles. On screen: muscular, dark, short, tied back in a ponytail, brown, black loincloth with a sheathed knife strapped to the hip. The figure climbs, arms reaching and pulling the body upward, legs braced against the surface. Only in the last seconds do these movements slow and stop, and the figure comes to rest in the pose, spacing, framing, and lighting established by <Picture 2>.

overall_soundscape: Room tone and air movement throughout, cloth rustle with every body movement, footsteps wherever anyone moves.

non_diegetic_music: Low sustained strings at a slow tempo with widely spaced woodwind notes, dynamics held quiet throughout.
